thread:
Jamal: seeing a sudden spike of 502/504 from hosted inference in us-east-1, started ~11:02 UTC. Customer ticket coming in. cc @Maria @Alex
Maria: customer ticket #12345 — repeated 504s and timeouts, they hit it during normal traffic. sample curl showing 504:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
```
Alex: looking at runtime traces — gateway->runtime 5xx surge 11:02-11:07. p95 token latency up, and GPU worker restarts on gpu-pool-3. lots of KV cache churn.
Sofia: infra checking node events + autoscaler now. seeing scale-up but pods pending due to taints.
ops-bot: INCIDENT created INCIDENT-20260317-1 severity=P2 assignee=Jamal
Maria: can we route affected traffic to Dedicated for impacted customers as a stopgap? also consider fallback to smaller model variant to reduce GPU pressure.
Jamal: starting targeted routing change for the affected customer IDs, will also open fallback policy for their route.
Alex: I'll patch runtime to reduce max batch size and disable long-prefetch to lower memory pressure. prepping a hotfix.
Alex: hotfix command preview:
```
./runtime-cli set-config --service inference --key max_batch --value 8
./runtime-cli set-config --service inference --key kv_prefetch --value false
```
deploy-bot: deploy hotfix-batcher-20260317 started by Alex
Sofia: adding temporary taint exception so new nodes can accept pods immediately. also raising scale-up concurrency.
Alex: after routing + hotfix saw 5xx count drop ~70% within 3m. latency still a bit elevated.
Maria: updated customer with mitigation steps and ETA for full remediation. offered credits.
Jamal: quick action items from warroom: 1) postmortem doc (owner Jamal), 2) autoscaler fix to respect taint exceptions and faster node provisioning (owner Sofia), 3) runtime safety: failover for kv-cache storms + smaller default batch (owner Alex), 4) routing cookbook for targeted failovers (owner Jamal), 5) support playbook entry to escalate billing shows (owner Maria).
support-bot: Ticket #12345 updated: mitigation applied, customer notified, status=monitoring
Maria: I'll follow up with customer tonight once metrics are stable :white_check_mark:
Alex: follow-up engineering tasks: add load test sim that simulates long-lived streams + KV churn, and add an alert for worker OOM/restart rate.
Sofia: will add autoscaler p95 spin-up time and taint-scheduling failures to the infra dashboard.
Jamal: summarizing: mitigations applied, routing fallback worked, hotfix reduced memory pressure, autoscaler gaps found. closing warroom, creating postmortem skeleton and remediation tickets now.
Maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
Alex: noted — will include config diffs and logs in postmortem.
Sofia: ping when postmortem draft is up, I'll add infra timeline.
Jamal: last check 11:09 UTC — moving to monitoring.
